or at least steps to reproduce the behavior:

// Paste your code here

## Where did you hit this?

## Your Environment

- *runtime version*: i.e. node v24, deno, browser xy
- *i18next version*: i.e. 27.2.9
- *os*: Mac, Windows, Linux
